summary: Create one PTY; command is sent once to its shell
usage: corral terminal create [--worktree VALUE] [--title VALUE] [--command VALUE] [--focus] [--request-id VALUE] [--help] [--json] [--timeout-ms VALUE] [--socket VALUE] [--instance VALUE]
notes: Local macOS terminal backend guard v1 required (app/scripts/build-terminal-backend.sh); no automatic fallback to unguarded effects.
Handles bind profile, backend boot and PTY generation; runtime restart preserves handles when backend survives. Handles are not dispatch authorization.
Process conditions are unsupported and rejected without effects; general send targets current foreground.
Raw retention: last 1048576 bytes per PTY, backend lifetime; cursor is byte offset plus UTF-8 decoder carry. bytesBase64 is lossless; text is decoded UTF-8.
Read limit: 1..262144 bytes; screen limit: 1..262144 UTF-8 bytes; list limit: 1..10000. Input/command max 65536 UTF-8 bytes, title max 1024 bytes. NUL rejected.
Ready means transport, send means backend accepted, neither means application consumption or task completion. Close exitCode is null.

Request IDs: r1.<13-digit Unix milliseconds>.<UUID>, mint immediately before a new create/send; CLI mints if omitted. Retention 24 hours/10000 receipts; missing receipt for an admitted/older request or a pending receipt is unknown, never re-executed; lost results still count toward this runtime’s capacity.
Headless supports all commands except switch/focus and create --focus. Rename applies to every pane in the tab.
